According to our size chart, a 70 cm waist matches **size M** (bust 88 cm, waist 70 cm, hips 96 cm) [1].

Your bust and hip measurements matter too. If they fall between two sizes, we recommend ordering the larger size [1]. For example, if your hips are 98 cm, you are between M (96) and L (102), so L would be the better choice.

If your measurements don't fit neatly into one size, any dress can be tailored to your exact measurements. This costs an extra 1,500 MKD and adds 7 working days to delivery [1].

Based on our sources, your tailored dress should arrive in about 11 to 13 working days:

- Delivery to Kosovo takes 4 to 6 working days [1].
- Custom tailoring adds 7 working days to the delivery time [2][3].

That makes 7 + (4 to 6) = 11 to 13 working days in total.
